name: Reporting Module Customization
description: E2E tests for the module customization layer: analytics catalog API, module customization CRUD, and integration with report execution. API-driven tests that verify the backend endpoints the frontend UI calls.

phases.name: Authentication & Setup
steps: Login with valid credentials and receive JWT token
Verify analytics catalog endpoint is accessible

phases.name: Analytics Catalog API
steps: GET /api/v1/analytics/catalog returns tables array
Catalog includes expected tables (client_matters, invoices, tasks)
Each table has columns with labels, types, and capabilities
Catalog includes all 6 metric functions
Catalog includes granularities and filter operators

phases.name: Ad-Hoc Query Execution
steps: Execute simple count query on client_matters
Execute query with dimension grouping (status)
Execute query with time dimension (monthly granularity)
Execute query with filter (status equals active)
Verify org isolation — query always returns org-scoped data
Invalid table name returns validation error
Invalid metric format returns validation error

phases.name: Module Customization CRUD
steps: GET /api/v1/module-customizations returns empty list initially
POST creates a new customization with metric overrides
GET /:id returns the created customization
PUT /:id updates the customization description
POST /:id/set-default marks it as default
GET /modules/:key/effective returns the default customization
POST /:id/clone creates a copy with new name
DELETE /:id soft-deletes the customization
Verify max 10 customizations per module per org limit

phases.name: Customization Validation
steps: Reject invalid metric key format (missing dot)
Reject column not in SAFE_COLUMNS allowlist
Reject customization without required name field
Accept valid replace mode with proper metrics

phases.name: Report Import Cleanup
steps: Verify re-import deactivates existing customizations for that report
